items.title: Gucci Fall 2026 Ready-to-Wear (SS27) Runway Review
items.summary: WWD's runway review of Demna's third Gucci collection, 'The Store Show', staged as a mock boutique in Milan's Portello district, blending equestrian codes with fetish-inflected tailoring; review frames it as his first fully personal statement for the house.

items.title: Gucci e la sfilata 'effetto store' alla Milano Fashion Week
items.summary: Italian business-fashion outlet calls Demna's boutique-set SS27 show his most commercially convincing Gucci collection yet, but flags that pre-show messaging framing it as revolutionary may have overstated the actual degree of change, and that reception on social media was divisive.

items.title: A Milan, Demna chez Gucci mele aristocratie et culture pop
items.summary: French-language trade coverage of the SS27 show describes Demna combining aristocratic codes with pop culture references, part of the broader French media wave (FashionNetwork, FashionUnited, Numero) covering the Milan presentation as a turning point for the house.

items.title: Miu Miu scala 29 posizioni, Gucci scivola al quinto posto (Brand Finance Italy 100)
items.summary: Brand Finance's 2026 Italy 100 ranking shows Gucci dropping from third to fifth place in brand value while Miu Miu surges 29 spots; report attributes Gucci's decline to weakened brand strength index, softer Chinese demand, and margin/revenue pressure. Older item retained only for context of ongoing critical narrative -- not counted as fresh buzz.

items.title: Kering Q2 2026: Gucci organic sales decline narrows to -2%
items.summary: Kering group revenue rose 1% in Q2 2026 as Gucci's organic sales decline narrowed to 2% (from -8% in Q1), helped by leather goods returning to growth on the new Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches; recurring operating margin improved 40bps. Retained as background financial context though outside the 72h freshness window.

items.title: PurseForum thread: Demna's Fashion Show Premier
items.summary: Active community thread of handbag enthusiasts discussing Demna's SS27 'Store Show'; posters generally reacted positively, with comments that the collection 'made Gucci look cool and young again', alongside debate over specific bag styles shown.

items.title: Thai ambassadors PP Krit and Billkin trend on X during Gucci Milan show
items.summary: X trending topic tracking fan posts about Thai actors and Gucci ambassadors PP Krit and Billkin arriving in Milan for the SS27 show, with fans highlighting PP Krit's leather bomber look and Billkin's Jackie Flap bag; volume driven by fandom rather than critical commentary.

items.title: Cardi B makes dramatic entrance at Gucci's 'The Store Show' in Milan
items.summary: Cardi B's oversized-fur-coat entrance at the SS27 show went viral on social platforms; one widely shared post likened the theatrics to 'a mafia boss', occurring around the 13-minute livestream mark and drawing heavy fan commentary.

items.title: Jannik Sinner sits front row with Anna Wintour at Gucci's Milan show
items.summary: Gucci global ambassador Jannik Sinner attended the SS27 show front row beside Anna Wintour, generating crossover sports-fashion media coverage in Italy and beyond; coverage frames his presence as reinforcing the brand's celebrity-ambassador strategy.

items.title: Les invites du premier defile de Demna pour Gucci
items.summary: French TikTok news account Brut posted a roundup video of celebrity guests at Demna's Gucci show, part of a wave of short-form video coverage (also from W Magazine, nssmagazine) that drove fashion-community engagement around the Milan event.

items.title: Gucci second-hand sales increase while sales of new products decline
items.summary: Trade report on a structural disconnect: Gucci pre-owned sales on resale platforms (Jackie and Marmont bags most popular) are thriving even as sales of new Gucci products decline, read by analysts as a sign that brand desirability persists even where full-price purchase intent has weakened. Included as ongoing critical-angle context though outside the freshness window; no fresher secondhand-market item was found today.

items.title: Kering: il piano di de Meo mette in agitazione i sindacati, sciopero il 20 maggio
items.summary: Italian unions call a strike across Kering brands including Gucci in response to CEO Luca de Meo's ReconKering restructuring plan, which includes roughly 100 store closures in 2026 (250 by 2030) and a 20% SKU reduction at Gucci; retained as background on labor unrest despite being outside the freshness window since no newer labor story surfaced today.
